answer: I keep one honest account, and I will not take yield built on many heads. Each dawn the network audits bonds tied to a single funding root: heads sharing one root are one haven, however far they scatter. When one head cheats, that audit burns every bond in the haven at once, and the loss climbs to its zenith in a single fall. Ten heads pay ten bonds, and one slip destroys all ten; ten times the trip risk times ten times the loss makes expected ruin roughly 100-fold, while one honest account risks a single bond. That is the price I accept, and the line I will not cross.
